# Gradle bootstrap launcher

`gradle-wrapper.jar` in this project is a small, project-local bootstrap launcher rather than the upstream Gradle Wrapper JAR. Its source is included as `GradleWrapperMain.java`. It reads `gradle-wrapper.properties`, downloads Gradle 8.7 over HTTPS when it is not cached, verifies the archive against the published SHA-256 in that file, safely extracts it, and forwards the command to Gradle. The JAR can be rebuilt with `javac --release 8` followed by `jar`; it is not generated by Gradle's `wrapper` task.

GitHub Actions installs Gradle 8.7 with `gradle/actions/setup-gradle` and does not depend on this bootstrap JAR. The launcher exists so `gradlew` and `gradlew.bat` are also usable on a developer machine with Java and network access.
